methodology.question: Can sequential averaging across constant risk-sleeve mixtures provide a useful growth-adaptive allocation without noisy forecast-mean optimization or selecting a historical best weight? One fixed continuous-prior learner,not a weight grid or revival of the failed variance partition.
methodology.information_sleeves: Use the original actual price panel. At each completed month end,SOXX/GLD gross relatives are current adjusted close divided by previous completed month-end close. The four-style core relative is the arithmetic mean of the four individual fund relatives,equal starting monthly capital,not a daily-rebalanced synthetic index or a new traded asset.
methodology.prior_and_update: Uniform Dirichlet(1,1,1) over the complete three-sleeve simplex. Weight each constant mixture by its product of observed monthly gross relative scores. Compute its mean weights exactly by a normalized Dirichlet-moment polynomial recursion;no sampled experts,quadrature grid for allocation,temperature,forgetting,lookback or fitted prior. Floating-point evaluation is independently checked by polynomial-exact Gaussian quadrature.
methodology.clock: The first observed completed month end is only an anchor. Update only after the next completed month-end close;do not invent a return for the initial partial month or treat a truncated file end as a month end. Learning uses all preceding complete intervals and never resets for the five-year account. The current completed close can inform only the original later1/2-session execution.
methodology.allocation: At each original131source decision,retain its exact BIL and total non-BIL dollar-guard budget. Split non-BIL among the learned core,SOXX,GLD fractions;divide core equally among four actual factor funds. The old half-SOXX and30%-70%stock/gold split are explicitly replaced by this new simplex architecture,not altered in old studies or treated as user hard constraints. All actual targets remain long-only/cash-funded/98%total.
methodology.execution: One actual funded account,not wealth-averaged independently capitalized expert accounts. Use unchanged monthly observed0.025holding band,USD1tickets,5/20bp,1/2session delayed opens,fractional1x units/freshUSD10000,originalRF/initialpeak and full10y/5ywindows. Score states do not include fees and are not candidate net returns;acceptance uses only the actual funded account.
methodology.source_scope: Original option quotes may authenticate the frozen donor targets but do not determine the new simplex fractions. Reuse the saved own-vintage dollar guard without retiming/reconstructing it. No market download,new family,source fallback,old account or target-generator replay.
methodology.limits: This gross-score learner is not a transaction-cost universal-portfolio theorem,predictive-likelihood DMA,forward-return forecast or guaranteed Sharpe/DD/netbenchmark improvement. Past score adaptation can lag regime changes,concentrate risks or increase tickets. Algebraic moment states are not individually screened historical strategy configurations.
methodology.selection: One fixed adaptive hypothesis after193exposed completions. No expert-grid/prior/temperature/forgetting/asset/clock/band search;no hindsight best mixture selected. Preserve every prior failure and broader stable references. A historical point pass is not selection-adjusted or independent prospective proof.
